title: One language for geometric relationships
讓幾何關係回到同一種語言
plain: Put two sticks on a table. You can ask how much they point the same way, or how large a patch they enclose. Geometric algebra is a way to keep both answers when you multiply the arrows represented by those sticks.
把兩根棍子放在桌上。你可以問：它們朝同一方向的程度有多少？也可以問：它們張成的面積有多大？幾何代數讓箭頭相乘時，把這兩個答案一起留下。
analogy: A map can record both how far you walk along a road and which way you turn at a junction. You do not need to choose one and throw away the other. Think of geometric multiplication as a record with two different kinds of entry.
地圖可以同時記下沿著路走多遠，以及在路口朝哪邊轉，不必選一個、丟掉另一個。你可以先把幾何乘法想成一份有兩種欄位的紀錄。
precise: An arrow is called a vector. Its alignment with another arrow is the dot product, an ordinary number. Their oriented area is the wedge product: it keeps both the size of a patch and its direction of turning. The geometric product combines these two pieces. The following lessons name and test each piece before using it.
有方向的箭頭叫向量。兩支箭頭朝同一方向的程度，用內積記錄，答案是普通數；它們張成的定向面積，用外積記錄，連轉向也留下。幾何積把這兩部分放在一起。後面的課程會逐一替這些零件命名、做小測試，再拿來使用。
example: Two parallel unit arrows have alignment 1 and area 0. Turn one by 90°: alignment becomes 0 and oriented area becomes 1. Try those two settings in the diagram before reading the symbols.
兩支平行的單位箭頭，平行程度是 1，面積是 0。把其中一支轉 90°，平行程度變成 0，定向面積變成 1。先在圖上試這兩個位置，再看符號。
legend: a and b are arrows. ab means their geometric product. The dot · keeps alignment; the wedge ∧ keeps oriented area.
a、b 是兩支箭頭；ab 表示幾何積。點號 · 留下平行程度，楔號 ∧ 留下定向面積。

title: The geometric product: alignment plus oriented area
幾何積：平行程度，加上定向面積
plain: Order matters for an oriented patch. Walking along one side and then the other turns you around the patch one way. Reverse the order and the turn goes the other way, although the patch is the same size.
有方向的面積在意順序。先沿一條邊走、再沿另一條邊走，會繞著面朝一個方向轉；交換順序，轉向就反過來，即使面積大小相同。
analogy: Trace two sides of a square: right then up, or up then right. Both routes reach the same opposite corner, but the two arrows occur in opposite turning orders. A clockwise or counterclockwise mark distinguishes those orders.
沿正方形的兩條邊走：先右再上，或先上再右。兩條路都到對角，但箭頭出現的轉向順序相反。加上一個順時針或逆時針記號，就能分辨這兩種順序。
precise: The plane part is called a bivector. In two perpendicular unit directions e₁ and e₂, write their oriented unit patch as e₁₂. Then e₁e₂=e₁₂ and e₂e₁=−e₁₂. The minus sign reverses orientation. Adding the two orders cancels the plane part; subtracting them cancels the shared scalar part.
平面這一部分叫雙向量。把兩個垂直的單位方向寫成 e₁、e₂，它們的定向單位面積寫成 e₁₂，就有 e₁e₂=e₁₂、e₂e₁=−e₁₂。負號反轉的是方向。把兩種順序相加，平面部分消掉；相減，則共同的純量部分消掉。
example: For perpendicular unit arrows, the two products are +e₁₂ and −e₁₂. Their average is 0: no alignment. Half their difference is e₁₂: one oriented square. For parallel unit arrows, both products are 1 instead.
垂直單位箭頭的兩種乘法順序，答案是 +e₁₂ 和 −e₁₂。平均值是 0，表示沒有平行部分；差的一半是 e₁₂，留下定向單位面積。若換成平行單位箭頭，兩種順序的答案都變成 1。
legend: ab and ba use the same arrows in opposite order. Their sum keeps the part unchanged by order; their difference keeps the part that flips.
ab、ba 是同一對箭頭的相反乘法順序。相加留下交換後不變的部分，相減留下交換後變號的部分。

title: Eight coefficients, four grades
八個分量，四種階數
plain: A point-sized amount, an arrow, a patch and a volume record different kinds of geometry. In three-dimensional space we can keep all four kinds in one list, with a separate slot for each independent piece.
一個數量、一支箭頭、一片面積、一塊體積，記錄不同種類的幾何。在三維空間裡，我們能把它們放進同一張清單，每種獨立的零件各有自己的位置。
analogy: Arrange storage boxes in a cupboard: count the boxes, line them up, cover the floor, then stack upward. Count, direction, area and volume are different geometric records.
在儲物櫃裡擺收納箱：先數箱子，接著排成一列、鋪出底面，再往上堆。件數、排列方向、面積與體積，是不同種類的幾何紀錄。
precise: Grade names the number of directions used to build a piece: 0 for scalars, 1 for vectors, 2 for bivectors and 3 for volumes. A multivector collects several grades. In three Euclidean directions, the independent slots number 1, 3, 3 and 1. Those eight slots describe the algebra; they are not eight spatial directions.
階數（grade）說明一個零件用了幾個方向：純量是 0 階，向量是 1 階，雙向量是 2 階，體積是 3 階。多重向量把不同階數收在一起。三維歐氏空間各階的獨立位置有 1、3、3、1 個，共八個；這是代數的分量數，不是空間有八個方向。
example: The three arrows are right, forward and up. The three patches are right-forward, right-up and forward-up. Add one scalar and one oriented volume: 1+3+3+1=8 slots.
三支箭頭是右、前、上；三種平面是右前、右上、前上。再加一個純量與一個定向體積，就得到 1+3+3+1=8 個位置。
legend: The four terms count scalar, vector, plane and volume coefficients, in that order. A coefficient is the number stored in one labelled slot.
四個加數依序計算純量、向量、平面與體積的分量數。分量就是放在某個已標記位置上的數字。

title: Complex numbers, quaternions and tensors
複數、四元數與張量的關係
plain: You may already know two ways to store turns: complex numbers for a plane and quaternions for three dimensions. Geometric algebra lets us recognize them inside a common multiplication system.
你可能已經看過兩種記錄旋轉的工具：平面上的複數，以及三維的四元數。幾何代數讓我們在同一套乘法中，認出這些熟悉的工具。
analogy: The same journey can be written as street names or drawn as a line on a map. The notations look different, but converting between them can preserve the route. Here we are translating rotation records, rather than throwing away one language.
同一段路可以寫成街道名稱，也可以在地圖上畫成線。寫法不同，互相轉換仍能保留路線。這裡做的也是翻譯旋轉的紀錄，不是丟掉其中一種語言。
precise: A unit plane bivector B behaves like the complex imaginary unit i: each squares to −1. In a plane, a scalar plus a multiple of B therefore follows complex arithmetic. In three dimensions, the scalar and the three plane slots follow quaternion arithmetic after a consistent choice of signs. Tensor algebra can also be used to construct Clifford algebra; the tools are related.
單位平面雙向量 B 和複數的 i 有一個相同規則：平方都等於 −1。因此在一個平面裡，「純量加上 B 的倍數」會遵守複數運算。三維的純量加三個平面位置，選好一致的符號後，則遵守四元數運算。張量代數也能拿來構造克利福德代數，這些工具有明確的關係。
example: A quarter-turn in a plane is represented by i in complex arithmetic. In the plane generated by e₁ and e₂, e₁₂ has the same square: e₁₂e₁₂=−1. This matches a multiplication rule; the rotor lesson will explain the separate half-angle rule for rotating arrows.
複數乘法用 i 表示平面的四分之一圈。在 e₁、e₂ 張成的平面裡，e₁₂ 也有 e₁₂e₁₂=−1 的規則。這是在比較乘法規則；真正把箭頭旋轉時，還有下一節會解釋的轉子半角規則。
legend: i is the usual imaginary unit. B is a chosen oriented unit plane, such as e₁₂. Sharing a multiplication rule does not make every physical use of i the same spatial object.
i 是熟悉的虛數單位，B 是選定的定向單位平面，例如 e₁₂。共用乘法規則，不代表每個物理問題中的 i 都是同一個空間物件。

title: Rotate in a plane, not just around an axis
在平面中旋轉，不只繞軸想像
plain: To turn an arrow, choose the plane it turns in and the angle it turns through. A rotor is a compact record of that turn. We apply it to an arrow and obtain the arrow’s new direction.
要旋轉一支箭頭，先選它在哪個平面裡轉，再選轉多少角度。轉子就是這個旋轉動作的簡潔紀錄。把它作用到箭頭上，就得到新的方向。
analogy: Imagine two hands moving around a clock: one shows the arrow’s angle; the other moves at half speed. The half-speed hand stores the rotor. Applying the rotor uses it on both sides of the arrow, so the arrow makes the full turn.
想像兩支時鐘指針：一支顯示箭頭的角度，另一支只走一半速度。慢的那支記錄轉子。轉子作用時，會在箭頭左右各用一次，箭頭最後就轉完整角度。
precise: Write the rotation plane as B and the angle as θ. For a Euclidean unit plane, B²=−1. The rotor R contains the cosine and sine of half the angle. Its reverse, written R̃, undoes a unit rotor. The sandwich RvR̃ rotates the vector v. This avoids the particular gimbal-lock problem of Euler-angle coordinates; normalization and interpolation still need care.
把旋轉平面寫成 B，角度寫成 θ。歐氏單位平面有 B²=−1。轉子 R 用半角的 cos、sin 記錄旋轉；它的反轉記成 R̃，對單位轉子能撤銷旋轉。把向量 v 夾在中間，RvR̃ 就是新方向。這能避開歐拉角座標的萬向節鎖問題，但數值正規化與插值仍要小心。
example: Choose the right-up plane and set θ=90°. The rotor uses 45° internally, while a right-pointing arrow ends up pointing up. Drag the slider and compare the two dials.
選桌面的右上平面，把 θ 設成 90°。轉子內部記的是 45°，原本向右的箭頭最後卻向上。拖動滑桿，比較兩只錶盤走了多少。
legend: R records the turn, B names its oriented plane, θ is the full angle, v is the original arrow, and v′ is the result. The tilde on R̃ means reverse the order of its basis factors.
R 記錄旋轉，B 指定定向平面，θ 是完整角度，v 是原箭頭，v′ 是結果。R̃ 上面的波浪號表示把基底因子的乘法順序反過來。

title: Why a spinor remembers a full turn
旋量為什麼記得轉過一圈
plain: An arrow returns after one turn. The half-speed record does not: it has reached the opposite side of its dial. An electron’s quantum state also remembers a full turn through a change of sign. This calls for a different rotation rule from the one for arrows.
箭頭轉一圈就復原，半速紀錄卻只走到錶盤的另一邊。電子的量子態也會用一次變號記住轉過一整圈，所以它需要和箭頭不同的旋轉規則。
analogy: Watch the two dials. After 360°, the direction hand is back but the phase hand points the other way. After 720°, both return. The phase hand pictures a position within a wave cycle, not a tiny ball spinning inside the electron.
看兩只錶盤：360° 後，方向指針復原，相位指針卻朝另一邊；720° 後兩支才一起回來。相位指針表示波在一個週期裡的位置，不是電子裡有顆小球在自轉。
precise: A spinor is a quantum-state record that transforms with a spin rotation rule. For spin ½, a full spatial turn changes the sign of the state ψ. That global sign alone leaves measurement probabilities unchanged. A relative sign between rotated and unrotated branches can shift interference. The rotor is a useful rotation record, but general spinors need not be normalized rotors.
旋量是遵守自旋旋轉規則的量子態紀錄。對自旋 ½ 而言，完整空間旋轉會讓量子態 ψ 變號。只有整體負號時，測量機率不變；若與沒轉過的分支比較，相對負號就能影響干涉。轉子是理解旋轉的好工具，但一般旋量不一定是正規化轉子。
example: Press 360° and then 720°. A single spin component’s amplitude can go from +1 to −1 to +1. Its squared magnitude is 1 each time, so the sign requires an interference comparison to become visible.
依序按 360°、720°。一個自旋分量的振幅可從 +1 變成 −1，再回到 +1；絕對值平方每次都是 1，所以要比較干涉，才能看見符號的影響。
legend: ψ names the quantum state. Each arrow adds one full spatial turn. The minus sign changes phase, while the probability uses squared magnitudes.
ψ 是量子態的名字，每支箭頭代表再轉一整圈。負號改變相位，機率則看振幅的絕對值平方。

title: Rigid motion: projective geometric algebra
剛體運動：射影幾何代數
plain: A robot gripper must both turn and move. We would like one record that can store the whole motion and combine it with the next motion in the right order.
機械夾爪不只要轉向，也要移到另一個位置。我們希望用一份紀錄存下整個動作，再和下一個動作依順序接起來。
analogy: Pick up a triangle cut from card. Turn it on the table, then slide it to the right. Swap those steps and it can finish somewhere else. The triangle keeps its size and shape; only its pose changes.
拿一片三角形紙板，在桌上先轉一下，再向右推。交換兩個步驟，終點可能不同。三角形的大小、形狀沒變，改的是位置和朝向。
precise: A rigid motion preserves distances. Projective geometric algebra, usually shortened to PGA, provides records for points, lines, planes and these motions. Its motion record is called a motor. Multiplying motors combines motions, with the rightmost action performed first. Rigid-motion matrices and unit dual quaternions also describe this geometry; PGA organizes it in one algebra.
保持距離不變的動作，叫剛體運動。射影幾何代數（Projective Geometric Algebra，PGA），能記錄點、線、平面與這些動作；它的運動紀錄叫 motor。把 motor 相乘就能接起動作，右邊的先做。剛體矩陣與單位雙四元數也能描述這套幾何，PGA 則把它們整理在同一套代數裡。
example: On a tabletop, start at (1,0). Rotate 90° about the origin, then move right by 1: the result is (1,1). Move first and rotate afterwards: the result is (0,2). Order belongs in the motion record.
在桌面上，從 (1,0) 出發。先繞原點轉 90°，再向右移 1，得到 (1,1)；先向右移 1 再轉，卻得到 (0,2)。所以動作紀錄必須記住順序。
legend: M₁ is the first motion and M₂ the second. M_total combines them. A PGA motor acts on an encoded geometric object using the same two-sided pattern as a rotor.
M₁ 是第一個動作，M₂ 是第二個，M_total 把兩者接起來。PGA motor 作用於編碼後的幾何物件時，也使用轉子的左右夾乘形式。

title: Spacetime algebra and hyperbolic rotations
時空代數與雙曲旋轉
plain: An observer who moves past you mixes what you call elapsed time with what you call distance. This change of viewpoint resembles a rotation, but the rule preserves a difference of squares rather than a sum.
一位從你身旁勻速經過的觀測者，會把你記的時間差和距離重新混合。這種換視角有點像旋轉，但保留的是平方的差，不是平方的和。
analogy: On a clock-and-distance diagram, light rays draw a cone boundary. A moving observer tilts the time direction while keeping that boundary fixed. The picture shows a change of measuring frame, not an object being spun through time.
在時間與距離的圖上，光線畫出光錐的邊界。運動中的觀測者會把時間方向傾斜，卻保留這條邊界。圖示是在換量測框架，不是把物體拿來繞時間軸轉。
precise: A boost is the change between inertial observers moving at constant relative velocity. Spacetime algebra uses one time direction and three spatial directions, with opposite square signs, to encode that rule. For this picture set the speed of light to 1, so time and distance share units. Ordinary spatial turns use circles; boosts use hyperbolas.
Boost 是兩個相對勻速運動的慣性觀測者之間的變換。時空代數用一個時間方向與三個空間方向，讓兩類方向的平方帶相反符號，來編碼這條規則。圖中把光速設成 1，讓時間與距離使用相同單位。普通旋轉沿圓走，boost 則沿雙曲線走。
example: The events (t,x)=(1,0) and (1.25,0.75) have the same value of t²−x²: both give 1. In the diagram, the purple time direction moves while staying on that same unit hyperbola.
事件座標 (t,x)=(1,0) 和 (1.25,0.75) 有相同的 t²−x²，答案都是 1。圖中的紫色時間方向會移動，但仍留在同一條單位雙曲線上。
legend: t is elapsed time and x is displacement in one spatial direction, with c=1. The unchanged difference is the spacetime interval for this example.
t 是時間差，x 是一個方向的位移，這裡採用 c=1。保持不變的平方差，就是本例的時空間隔。

title: Dirac fields: where the algebra meets fermions
狄拉克場：代數如何作用於費米子
plain: To predict how an electron’s state changes, we need both its special rotation record and a rule connecting nearby places and times. The Dirac equation puts these ingredients together.
要預測電子的狀態怎麼改變，既要記得它特殊的旋轉規則，也要有一條規則連起鄰近的位置與時刻。狄拉克方程把這些材料放在一起。
analogy: A musical score records several notes and tells you how they change with time. The symbols are not the sound itself, but a compact set of instructions for its evolution. Think of the electron’s state as the record and the equation as its evolution rule.
樂譜記下幾個聲部，還告訴你它們如何隨時間改變。符號不是聲音本身，而是一份濃縮的演變說明。電子的量子態像紀錄，方程像讓這份紀錄往下演變的規則。
precise: ψ denotes a spinor field: an electron-state record at each location. The γ symbols are fixed algebraic operators linking its components and spacetime directions. ∂ asks how the state changes between nearby locations; m is mass. With no electromagnetic field and with light-speed and quantum-action units set to 1, these pieces form the free Dirac equation. Curved spacetime needs additional comparison rules for local frames.
ψ 表示旋量場，也就是每個位置上的電子狀態紀錄。γ 符號是固定的代數操作，把狀態分量與時空方向連起來；∂ 詢問鄰近位置之間的變化，m 是質量。不加電磁場，並把光速與量子作用量的單位設成 1，就得到自由狄拉克方程。彎曲時空還需要比較不同位置標架的規則。
example: For a simple normalized two-component spin record (1,0), the probabilities of its two chosen spin outcomes are 1 and 0. Changing it to (0,1) swaps those probabilities. This first checks what a state record means; it does not solve the full Dirac equation.
先拿簡單的兩分量自旋紀錄 (1,0) 做檢查：在選定量測方向的兩種結果，機率是 1 和 0；改成 (0,1)，兩個機率就交換。這是在弄清楚狀態紀錄的意思，還不是已解出完整狄拉克方程。
legend: i is the imaginary unit; μ runs over time and three spatial directions, with repeated μ summed. The γ operators are chosen to obey spacetime’s multiplication rule. Multiplying ψ by an ordinary matrix is a way to compute these operators, not a replacement for the spinor transformation rule.
i 是虛數單位，μ 依序代表時間與三個空間方向，重複的 μ 表示把四項相加。γ 操作依時空的乘法規則選定。電腦可用矩陣作用於 ψ 來計算，但仍要遵守旋量本身的變換規則。

title: One electromagnetic bivector, observer-dependent E and B
同一個電磁雙向量，不同觀測者的 E 與 B
plain: An electric field tells us how a charge is pushed. A magnetic field adds a sideways effect for a moving charge. Different moving observers divide the same electromagnetic situation into different electric and magnetic parts.
電場告訴我們電荷會怎麼被推，磁場則對運動電荷加上側向的影響。不同運動狀態的觀測者，會把同一個電磁情景分成不同的電場與磁場部分。
analogy: A loaf looks different when sliced in different directions. The slices change, but they come from the same loaf. Here the observer’s time direction chooses how one electromagnetic field is split into electric and magnetic pieces.
同一條麵包，沿不同方向切，切面會不同；改的是切法，不是麵包。這裡是觀測者的時間方向，決定同一個電磁場如何分成電場與磁場。
precise: Call the combined electromagnetic record F. It can be stored as a spacetime bivector with six independent components. The symbol ∇ is a single instruction that collects changes along time and all spatial directions; J records charge and current sources. In flat spacetime and compatible natural units, ∇F=J packages Maxwell’s equations. Expanding by grade recovers the familiar source and no-magnetic-monopole equations.
把合在一起的電磁紀錄叫 F，可以用六個獨立分量的時空雙向量儲存。∇ 是把時間與各空間方向的變化合起來的微分操作，J 記錄電荷與電流來源。在平直時空與一致的自然單位下，∇F=J 能打包麥克斯韋方程；按階數拆開，就回到有源與無磁單極的熟悉方程。
example: For a plane wave in empty space there are no local charge or current sources, so J=0. That does not force F=0: a changing wave can satisfy ∇F=0 while travelling. The moving picture illustrates that nonzero field.
在空曠真空中的平面波，局部沒有電荷或電流源，所以 J=0。但這不會強迫 F=0；一個非零、隨時空變化的波，仍能滿足 ∇F=0 並向前傳播。動畫畫的就是這種非零場。
legend: F is the electromagnetic field, J its charge-current source, and ∇ collects spacetime derivatives. This is a compact rewriting of the same equations; physical units and signs must be consistent.
F 是電磁場，J 是電荷電流源，∇ 收集時空微分。這是同一套方程的簡寫，使用時仍要讓單位和符號約定一致。

title: A plane wave as a null bivector
平面光波：零範雙向量
plain: In an ideal plane light wave, the electric and magnetic fields point across the direction of travel and at right angles to each other. They are two parts of the same wave, not two separate objects chasing each other.
理想平面光波裡，電場和磁場都橫向於前進方向，而且互相垂直。它們是同一個波的兩個部分，不是兩件互相追逐的獨立物體。
analogy: Think of a flag attached along a moving pole: the pole picks the travel direction, and the fabric picks a transverse direction. This helps picture a direction paired with a plane. The drawing describes a classical wave, not a literal photon carrying a flag.
想像一面沿著桿子前進的旗：桿子選出傳播方向，旗面再選一個橫向方向。這能幫你想像「一條方向配上一片面」。圖示描述經典光波，不是說光子真的扛著旗子。
precise: Write the electric field as E and the magnetic field as B; multiply B by light speed c to compare their sizes. For an ideal vacuum plane wave, |E|=c|B| and E·B=0. The combined field is called null because its two invariant tests vanish. Null does not mean the field is absent. General mixtures of waves need not satisfy this condition.
電場寫成 E，磁場寫成 B；把 B 乘上光速 c，才能比較大小。理想真空平面波滿足 |E|=c|B|、E·B=0。合成場通過兩個值為零的不變量檢查，所以叫零範場；零範不表示沒有場。一般混合波不一定滿足這個條件。
example: In units with c=1, choose E=(1,0,0) and B=(0,1,0). Their squared magnitudes differ by 0, and their dot product is 0, yet both fields are nonzero. Switch between linear and circular polarization to see different transverse motion.
令 c=1，選 E=(1,0,0)、B=(0,1,0)。兩者長度平方相減是 0，內積也是 0，但兩個場都不是零。切換線偏振與圓偏振，看看不同的橫向變化。
legend: Vertical bars give a vector’s length, c is light speed, and · is the dot product. A zero dot product here means the fields are perpendicular.
直線符號 | | 取向量長度，c 是光速，· 是內積。此處內積為零，表示兩個場互相垂直。

title: Connections and geometric phase
聯絡與幾何相位
plain: To compare an arrow or a wave clock here with one somewhere else, we need a rule for carrying that information along the route. A round trip can leave a direction or wave phase different from its starting value.
要比較這裡和別處的箭頭、或波週期的小鐘，得先說明沿路怎麼把資訊帶過去。走回起點以後，方向或相位仍可能和出發時不同。
analogy: Imagine passing a direction marker from one traveller to the next around a curved surface. Each follows the local “keep going straight” rule. The marker can return turned. For a wave, imagine comparing the reading of a cycle clock after a loop instead.
想像旅人沿著彎曲表面，逐個傳遞一個方向標記；每一步都遵守當地的「直走」規則，繞回來卻可能轉了方向。若換成波，就想像繞一圈後，比較週期小鐘的讀數。
precise: A connection is that local comparison rule. Holonomy names the net change after a closed route. For electromagnetic phase, the Aharonov–Bohm effect compares two electron-wave paths around excluded magnetic flux. A loop can carry phase information even if the magnetic field vanishes along the paths. Spacetime rotations and electromagnetic phase rotations are different actions, despite this shared comparison idea.
這條局部比較規則叫聯絡（connection），繞一圈後的總變化叫 holonomy。電磁相位的 AB 效應，讓兩條電子波路徑繞過被排除的磁通，再比較相位。即使沿路磁場為零，迴路仍可能帶有相位資訊。時空旋轉和電磁相位旋轉是不同作用，只是都有這種比較的想法。
example: For two equally strong coherent paths, aligned phases can give a bright output, while a half-cycle difference can make that same output dark. The picture illustrates accumulation; it is not a calibrated prediction of the phase shift.
對兩條等強度且能相干的路徑，相位對齊時可在一個出口變亮；差半個週期時，同一出口則可能變暗。圖中只示意累積過程，不把錶盤角度當成實驗的定量預測。
legend: P is the probability at one output of an ideal balanced interferometer. Δφ is the relative phase: 0 means aligned; π means half a cycle apart.
P 是理想對稱干涉儀某個出口的機率。Δφ 是相對相位：0 表示對齊，π 表示差半個週期。

title: CPT, chirality and the limits of geometric analogies
CPT、手徵性與幾何比喻的邊界
plain: A mirror, playing a process backwards, and replacing particles with antiparticles are three different changes. Physicists ask whether the laws still work after each change, or after a combination.
照鏡子、把過程倒放、把粒子換成反粒子，是三種不同改變。物理學家會問：分別改變，或合在一起改變以後，定律還成不成立？
analogy: Watch a film of a collision. You can mirror the screen, reverse the film, or exchange every particle label for its antiparticle label. These are useful pictures for three tests, although the quantum time-reversal operation has more structure than an ordinary video rewind.
看一段碰撞影片，你可以把畫面左右反過來、倒放，或把所有粒子標籤換成反粒子。這能幫你記住三種測試，但量子時間反演的數學操作，比一般倒放影片還多一些結構。
precise: C names charge conjugation, P spatial reflection, and T time reversal. The CPT theorem says their combined action preserves a quantum field theory under its stated assumptions, including locality and Lorentz covariance. It does not follow just from turning a shape 180°. Likewise, labelling left- and right-chiral components separates kinds of fields; it does not by itself explain the weak interaction’s preference.
C 是電荷共軛，P 是空間反射，T 是時間反演。CPT 定理說，在局域性與洛侖茲協變性等適用假設下，三者的聯合作用保留量子場論的定律。這不是只把形狀轉 180° 就能推出。把場分成左右手徵分量，也只是分清楚種類，本身不會解釋弱作用的偏好。
example: If a property is called odd under reflection, reflection changes its sign: +1 becomes −1. Reflect again and +1 returns. This small sign test illustrates what a symmetry action does; it is not a proof of CPT.
如果一個量叫做反射下的「奇」量，反射一次就變號：+1 變 −1；再反射一次又回 +1。這個小測試先說明對稱操作會做什麼，並不是 CPT 的證明。
legend: Each arrow means one reflection. The example tracks only an odd quantity’s sign; a field transformation can contain more information.
每支箭頭代表一次反射。例子只追蹤奇量的符號，完整的場變換可能包含更多資訊。

title: Encode blades with bit masks
以位元遮罩編碼基底
plain: The computer needs a slot for every kind of piece. Before writing multiplication, decide which slot means “number”, which means “right arrow”, and which means “right-up plane”. The numbers alone do not carry those labels.
電腦要替每種零件安排一個位置。寫乘法以前，先說好哪格是普通數、哪格是向右箭頭、哪格是右上平面。只有數字本身，不會自動帶著這些標籤。
analogy: Give each direction a light switch. Right is 001, forward is 010, and up is 100. Turning on the first two switches gives 011: the plane using right and forward. A label can now tell us which directions a piece contains.
替每個方向安排一個開關：右是 001，前是 010，上是 100。前兩個開關一起打開就是 011，代表用了右和前的平面。這樣一個標籤就能告訴我們，零件包含哪些方向。
precise: This switch label is called a bit mask. Its integer values give the slot order: 0 scalar, 1 e₁, 2 e₂, 3 e₁₂, and so on. XOR, written ^ in Python, cancels a direction appearing twice and keeps one appearing once. The remaining sign comes from how often directions swap places and from the square assigned to a repeated direction.
這種開關標籤叫位元遮罩（bit mask）。把它讀成整數，就得到位置順序：0 是純量，1 是 e₁，2 是 e₂，3 是 e₁₂，依此類推。Python 的 ^ 是 XOR：同一方向出現兩次就抵消，只出現一次就留下。符號則要再計算方向交換了幾次，以及重複方向的平方規則。
example: e₁ uses mask 1 and e₂ mask 2. Their output mask is 1^2=3, the e₁₂ slot. Multiplying e₁ by itself gives 1^1=0, the scalar slot. In Euclidean space its coefficient is +1.
e₁ 的遮罩是 1，e₂ 是 2，輸出位置由 1^2=3 決定，也就是 e₁₂。e₁ 乘自己時，1^1=0，回到純量格；歐氏空間裡它的係數是 +1。
legend: e₁ and e₂ are perpendicular unit arrows; e₁₂ is their oriented unit plane. The Python snippet returns both an output slot and its sign.
e₁、e₂ 是垂直單位箭頭，e₁₂ 是它們的定向單位平面。下方程式會同時傳回輸出格和符號。

title: Implement the geometric product
實作幾何積
plain: A general record has several nonzero pieces. To multiply two records, multiply every piece of the first by every piece of the second, then add together answers that belong in the same slot.
一份紀錄可能有好幾個不為零的零件。兩份紀錄相乘，就把第一份的每個零件和第二份的每個零件配對相乘，再把落在同一格的答案加起來。
analogy: Imagine sorting deliveries. Each pair of input labels tells you the destination bin and whether to add or subtract the quantity. Different deliveries can reach the same bin, so you keep a running total there.
想像分送貨物：每對輸入標籤都告訴你要送到哪個箱子，以及該加上還是扣掉這份數量。不同批貨可能到同一箱，所以每箱都要累加。
precise: The function gp uses two loops for the pairs. blade_product supplies the destination mask and sign using the previous lesson’s rule. The list metric supplies each basis direction’s square: +1 for the Euclidean examples, or different signs for spacetime. Changing those squares changes the geometry while leaving the bookkeeping pattern intact.
gp 函式用兩層迴圈列出配對，blade_product 用上一節的規則提供目的格與符號。metric 清單記下每個基方向的平方：歐氏例子都是 +1，時空則用不同正負號。改變平方規則，就能換幾何，記帳方式仍相同。
example: Expand (1+e₁)e₂: the first piece gives e₂, and the second gives e₁₂. The output list therefore has coefficient 1 in each of those two slots. All other slots remain zero.
展開 (1+e₁)e₂：第一部分給出 e₂，第二部分給出 e₁₂。因此輸出清單在這兩格各有係數 1，其他格仍是零。
legend: 1 is the scalar slot, e₁ and e₂ the first two arrow slots, and e₁₂ the plane slot. Each input coefficient scales one delivery to an output slot.
1 是純量格，e₁、e₂ 是前兩個箭頭格，e₁₂ 是平面格。每個輸入係數，決定送往輸出格的份量。

title: Reverse, normalize, rotate
反轉、正規化、旋轉
plain: A turn should keep an arrow’s length while changing its direction. We can check that promise with a short piece of code instead of trusting the picture alone.
旋轉應該改變方向，卻保持箭頭長度。我們可以用一小段程式檢查這個承諾，不必只憑圖好看就相信。
analogy: If a sequence of steps takes you from A to B, undoing it requires taking the steps in reverse order. Reversing basis factors works in a similar way. For a unit rotor, that reverse is the operation that undoes its turn.
一串步驟把你從 A 帶到 B，要撤銷時，就得倒著做。把基底因子倒過來的反轉，也有類似用途；對單位轉子，它正好撤銷旋轉。
precise: reverse flips the order of factors. For an arrow it changes nothing; for a plane e₁e₂ it produces e₂e₁=−e₁e₂. Build a unit rotor R from the desired half-angle, compute its reverse, then use gp twice to sandwich the arrow. Reversal equals inversion here because the rotor is normalized; an arbitrary record need not have an inverse.
reverse 把因子的順序倒過來。單一箭頭沒有改變；平面 e₁e₂ 則變成 e₂e₁=−e₁e₂。用半角建立單位轉子 R，算出反轉，再用兩次 gp 把箭頭夾起來。這裡反轉能當反元素，是因為轉子已正規化；一般紀錄不保證可逆。
example: The snippet rotates e₁ by 90° in the e₁₂ plane. Check that the output is e₂, up to rounding. At 360° the arrow is back at e₁, even though the rotor record has become −1.
下方程式把 e₁ 在 e₁₂ 平面轉 90°。檢查輸出是否在四捨五入誤差內等於 e₂。轉到 360° 時箭頭回到 e₁，但轉子紀錄本身已變成 −1。
legend: The arrow above means rotate by 90°. The tilde means reverse the factor order; it changes the plane’s sign.
式中箭頭代表旋轉 90°，波浪號代表顛倒因子順序，因此平面部分會變號。

title: Check a null electromagnetic field
檢查零範電磁場
code:
metric = (1, -1, -1, -1)
k, a = [0.0]*16, [0.0]*16
k[1], k[8], a[2] = 1, 1, 1  # gamma0 + gamma3; gamma1
F = gp(k, a, metric)
assert any(abs(x) > 0 for x in F)
assert all(abs(x) < 1e-12 for x in gp(F, F, metric))
plain: An object can be nonzero while a particular test of it gives zero. The word null in spacetime uses that distinction. We can build a nonzero plane-wave field whose geometric square is zero.
一個東西不為零，不代表對它做的每一種檢查都不為零。時空裡的 null 就用到這個差別：我們能造出一個非零的平面波場，幾何平方卻是零。
analogy: Walking forward and back gives a zero net displacement, although you did walk. The analogy is cancellation in a test, not absence of activity. Spacetime’s different time and space signs allow a related cancellation in squared length.
走出去再走回來，淨位移是零，但你不是沒有走。這個比喻要記住的是「檢查結果抵消」，不等於「什麼都沒有」。時空對時間、空間採用不同符號，也允許平方長度的相消。
precise: Use four basis directions with squares (+1,−1,−1,−1). Let k contain one unit of time and one unit of forward travel, so k²=1−1=0. Choose a perpendicular sideways arrow a. Their product F=ka is a bivector; because k and a are perpendicular, it also equals their wedge product. F is nonzero but F²=0.
用四個平方依序為 (+1,−1,−1,−1) 的基方向。讓 k 包含一單位時間和一單位向前位移，就有 k²=1−1=0。再選一支垂直的側向箭頭 a。乘積 F=ka 是雙向量；因兩者垂直，它也等於外積。F 本身不為零，F² 卻為零。
example: The snippet puts the time and forward entries of k in slots 1 and 8, and the sideways entry of a in slot 2. It first checks that F has a nonzero coefficient, then checks that every coefficient of F² is zero. This algebraic test is not a full solution of the wave’s differential equation.
程式把 k 的時間與前進分量放在第 1、8 格，把 a 的側向分量放在第 2 格。先確認 F 確有非零分量，再檢查 F² 每格都為零。這是代數檢查，還不是解出整個波的微分方程。
legend: k is the lightlike travel direction, a is the transverse amplitude direction, and F their plane record. The square is geometric multiplication, not the sum of coefficient squares.
k 是光般傳播的方向，a 是橫向振幅方向，F 記錄兩者形成的面。這裡的平方是幾何乘法，不是把各分量平方後相加。

title: Equivariance is a design constraint
等變性是設計約束
code:
import torch

def equivariant_scale(x):
    norm2 = (x * x).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    return x / (1 + norm2)

# A 90-degree rotation, with vectors stored as rows.
x = torch.tensor([[1., 0., 0.], [0., 1., 0.]])
Q = torch.tensor([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
y1 = equivariant_scale(x @ Q.T)
y2 = equivariant_scale(x) @ Q.T
assert torch.allclose(y1, y2, atol=1e-5)
plain: Turn a scene before asking a model for a direction. Its answer should turn with the scene. If it predicts an energy, the number should stay the same instead. We must decide which promise each output makes.
先把場景轉一下，再請模型預測方向，答案也應該跟著轉。如果預測的是能量，數字反而應該保持相同。每種輸出要遵守哪個承諾，必須先說清楚。
analogy: Ask someone to point from a toy car’s centre to its front. Rotate the toy, and their finger should follow. Measuring the car’s mass gives a different sort of answer: a turn should not change the reading.
請一個人從玩具車中心指向車頭。把玩具轉一下，手指方向也應該跟著轉。換成量車的質量，要求就不同：旋轉不該改變秤上的數字。
precise: Equivariance means that transforming the input transforms the output in the matching way. Invariance means the output stays unchanged. A representation alone does not enforce either promise: every model operation must respect the chosen rule. For a simple example, scale an arrow by a function of its squared length. Rotating the arrow leaves that scale factor unchanged.
等變性表示輸入變換後，輸出也依對應方式變換；不變性表示輸出保持相同。光選一種表示，不會自動保證這些承諾，每個模型操作都要配合規則。一個簡單例子，是用箭頭長度平方的函數來縮放箭頭：旋轉不改長度，所以縮放倍數不變。
example: Scale the unit right arrow by one half, then turn 90°: the answer is a half-length up arrow. Turn first and scale afterwards: the same answer. The code divides by one plus squared length: a unit arrow is divided by 2. allclose compares the two routes with rounding tolerance.
把向右單位箭頭縮成一半，再轉 90°，得到半支向上箭頭；先轉再縮，答案相同。程式把箭頭除以「1 加長度平方」，所以單位箭頭除以 2。allclose 會容許小量浮點誤差，檢查兩條路的答案。
legend: x is the input arrow, Q a rotation, and f the scaling rule. The left side rotates first; the right side applies f first. The snippet stores vectors as rows, so it writes rotations with Q.T.
x 是輸入箭頭，Q 是旋轉，f 是縮放規則。左邊先轉，右邊先套用 f。程式把向量存成一列，所以用 Q.T 寫出相同的旋轉。

title: Geometry, storage and computational cost
幾何、儲存與計算成本
plain: A clear geometric description can still cost a lot to calculate. Keep the representation that helps the task, then measure how much time and memory its implementation actually uses.
幾何描述很清楚，計算起來仍可能很花時間。先選能幫助任務的表示，再量它的實作到底用了多少時間與記憶體。
analogy: A well-labelled toolbox helps you find the right piece. But carrying every possible tool to a small repair is expensive. A full geometric record also grows quickly as you add directions; sometimes the task only needs a few of its slots.
工具箱標示清楚，容易找到對的零件；但修一個小東西就搬出所有工具，也很費力。幾何紀錄隨方向數增加會快速變大，而一個任務可能只需要其中少數位置。
precise: With n independent directions, a full Clifford record has 2ⁿ coefficients. The simple two-loop multiplication visits every pair of coefficients, so the pair count is (2ⁿ)². Sparse records and specialized algorithms can save work. Tensor libraries can still store and calculate these records. Better accuracy, data efficiency and speed are separate measurements, not automatic consequences of a geometric name.
n 個獨立方向的完整克利福德紀錄，有 2ⁿ 個分量。最直接的雙迴圈乘法會走遍所有分量配對，配對數是 (2ⁿ)²。稀疏紀錄與專用算法可以省事，張量函式庫也能儲存、計算它們。準確率、資料效率和速度，要分別量測，不能只從名字有「幾何」就推定。
example: Three directions give 8 coefficients and 64 naive pairs. Four directions give 16 coefficients and 256 pairs. The direction count rose by one, but this simple multiplication visits four times as many pairs.
三個方向有 8 個分量，直接相乘要看 64 對；四個方向有 16 個分量，要看 256 對。方向只多一個，這個簡單乘法看的配對卻多四倍。
legend: 2ⁿ counts stored coefficients. Squaring that count gives the pairs visited by this teaching implementation, not a lower bound for every possible algorithm.
2ⁿ 計算儲存分量數，再平方就是這個教學實作走訪的配對數，不是所有可能算法的速度下限。

title: A reading path, not another wall of prerequisites
一條閱讀路徑，不再堆一堵先修牆
plain: Learn one relationship well enough to explain it without the formula. Then use a small calculation to find where your explanation is incomplete. That is a useful reading order as well as a useful study habit.
先把一個關係學到不用公式也能說清楚，再用一個小計算找出說明的缺口。這既是讀書習慣，也能當作閱讀順序。
analogy: Learning to cook one simple dish teaches more than reading a whole spice catalogue. Make it, taste it, find the missing step, and try again. Here the first dish is two arrows making a scalar and an oriented patch.
先做成一道簡單的菜，通常比背完整本香料目錄更有用。做、試味道、找漏掉的步驟，再做一次。這裡的第一道菜，就是兩支箭頭產生平行部分和定向面積。
precise: Begin with the geometric product and grades, then the 90° rotor example. Study spinors after you can explain the two dials. Next compare spatial turns with boosts, and electric-magnetic splitting with a change of observer. Use the coding lessons to test the rules. The books and papers linked below supply progressively more formal detail.
先讀幾何積與階數，再做 90° 轉子例子。能說清楚兩只錶盤之後，才讀旋量。接著比較空間旋轉與 boost，再讀換觀測者時電場、磁場如何重新分配。用程式課檢查規則，底下的書與論文則逐步補上更正式的細節。
example: Before leaving the first lesson, explain why perpendicular unit arrows give alignment 0 and area 1. If you need the equation to answer, return to the picture and move the second arrow between 0° and 90°.
離開第一課以前，試著說清楚：為什麼垂直單位箭頭的平行部分是 0，面積卻是 1？如果非看公式不能回答，就回到圖，把第二支箭頭在 0°、90° 之間移動。
legend: No new notation here. Follow a concrete example before opening the more formal references.
這節不加新符號，先走完一個具體例子，再打開更正式的資料。

title: The people behind the connections
把人物與貢獻放回正確位置
plain: The familiar tools were developed by different people answering different questions. Recognizing their connections is easier when we keep their names and contributions straight.
熟悉的工具，來自不同的人回答不同的問題。先把人物與貢獻分清楚，比較容易看出它們怎麼連起來。
analogy: A set of connected roads can have been built by different teams at different times. Today we can draw one map without pretending a single team built the entire network at once.
一張互相連通的路網，可能由不同時代的不同團隊建造。今天能畫出同一張地圖，不表示當初是一隊人一次造完整座路網。
precise: Hamilton developed quaternions; Hermann Grassmann developed exterior algebra; William Kingdon Clifford combined metric and exterior ideas. Marcel Grossmann is a different person from Grassmann: he helped Einstein use the differential geometry of relativity. Clifford’s early proposal connecting matter and spatial curvature was a geometric speculation, not Einstein’s later field equations.
哈密頓發展四元數，赫爾曼・格拉斯曼發展外代數，威廉・金頓・克利福德結合度規與外代數觀念。馬塞爾・格羅斯曼是另一位人物，他協助愛因斯坦使用相對論的微分幾何。克利福德早期把物質與空間曲率連起來的提案，是幾何推想，還不是後來的愛因斯坦場方程。
example: Keep two cards separate: Grassmann, exterior algebra; Grossmann, Einstein’s collaborator. Also check a book’s title page: Anyhow Stories was written by Lucy Clifford, William’s wife. A small attribution check prevents a memorable story from teaching the wrong fact.
先分開記兩張卡：Grassmann，外代數；Grossmann，愛因斯坦的合作者。書的作者也要看扉頁：《Anyhow Stories》是威廉的妻子露西・克利福德寫的。小小的出處檢查，能避免好記的故事教錯人。
legend: The links include original historical work and the literary title page; distinguish what each source actually establishes.
連結包含歷史原文與文學作品的扉頁，閱讀時留意每份資料實際支持的是哪件事。

title: Geometric learning: what the evidence supports
幾何學習：證據支持到哪裡
plain: A model learning from moving shapes should use the relationships that stay true when the shapes turn or move. Geometric neural networks build some of those promises into the calculations, rather than asking training data to teach every case from scratch.
讓模型從會動的形狀中學習時，可以利用形狀轉動、平移後仍成立的關係。幾何神經網絡把部分承諾放進計算規則裡，不必全靠資料從零教每一種情況。
analogy: If every training photo shows a toy pointing right, a model may learn the camera setup instead of the toy. A rule saying “turn the input, and turn this output with it” helps separate the scene from the viewpoint.
如果訓練照片裡的玩具永遠朝右，模型可能學到拍照角度，而不是玩具本身。加入「輸入轉了，這種輸出也要跟著轉」的規則，能幫忙分開物件和視角。
precise: Clifford Group Equivariant Neural Networks constructs layers that respect a chosen geometric group action. The Geometric Algebra Transformer, GATr, uses projective geometric algebra inside a transformer. Their reported gains belong to specific tasks and benchmarks. Selecting geometric features is not enough: learned maps, nonlinearities and attention must also respect the promised transformations.
Clifford Group Equivariant Neural Networks 建構遵守選定幾何群作用的網絡層；Geometric Algebra Transformer（GATr）則把射影幾何代數放進 Transformer。論文成果對應特定任務與基準。只選幾何特徵還不夠，學到的映射、非線性與注意力操作，也得遵守承諾的變換。
example: Compare two models on the same held-out rotated scenes. Record prediction error, training-data amount and runtime separately. A lower error on one benchmark does not imply every geometric model is faster on every task.
把兩個模型放到相同、沒參與訓練的旋轉場景上比較，分開記誤差、訓練資料量和運行時間。在一個基準誤差較小，不代表所有幾何模型在每種任務都比較快。
legend: x is a scene representation, Q the chosen rotation and f the model. This equation is the promise to test when the output should rotate like the input.
x 是場景表示，Q 是選定的旋轉，f 是模型。若輸出應像輸入一樣旋轉，這就是要驗證的承諾。

title: A map of ideas and their status
觀念地圖與證據狀態
plain: Some of the geometric connections here are proven mathematical rules. Some are physical theories supported by experiment. Others are candidate explanations still being tested. Keeping these categories apart makes the interesting ideas easier to evaluate.
這裡有些幾何關係是已證明的數學規則，有些是受實驗支持的物理理論，還有些是仍待檢驗的候選解釋。把它們分開，反而更容易判斷有趣的想法。
analogy: An architect’s drawing, a completed bridge and a load-test report each tell you something useful, but not the same thing. A beautiful drawing helps plan a bridge; it does not show that the bridge has carried traffic.
建築圖、已蓋好的橋、承重測試報告，都有用，但不是同一種證據。漂亮的設計圖能幫忙規劃橋，卻不能表示橋已經承受過車流。
precise: Geometric products and spinor representations are established mathematics. Relativistic quantum field theory and electromagnetic gauge symmetry have extensive experimental support. Geometric neural architectures are active engineering research. Extra dimensions, Kaluza–Klein charge models and Spin(10) unification are model proposals; this site does not treat their extra structures as observed facts.
幾何積與旋量表示是成熟數學；相對論量子場論與電磁規範對稱有大量實驗支持；幾何神經架構是持續發展的工程研究。額外維度、Kaluza–Klein 的電荷模型、Spin(10) 統一則是模型提案，不能把它們多加的結構直接當作已觀測事實。
example: Ask three questions about an impressive claim: what is the rule, what measured result does it predict, and what would show it wrong? A drawing that links all forces to rotation is a useful prompt for those questions, not their answer.
遇到震撼的主張，先問三件事：規則是什麼？預測哪個量測結果？什麼結果會推翻它？把所有作用力畫成旋轉，可以是提問的起點，還不是這些問題的答案。
legend: No new formula is needed. Follow the source links and separate the mathematical result, the measured evidence and the model’s extra assumptions.
這裡不需要新公式。沿著來源閱讀，分開找出數學結果、量測證據，以及模型多加的假設。
